title: Patrol at the Wells
blurb: A corsair patrol is sniffing round the wells again. Send them home.

title: The Powder Cart
blurb: A powder cart is creeping up the Sciberras road under a small escort. Burn it, and its quartermaster.

title: The Night Picket
blurb: A line of Turkish pickets has crept down to the shore at Marsaxlokk. Clear them out before dawn.

title: Spiking the Guns
blurb: Turgut's new battery at Tigné is lightly held tonight. Spike the guns and bring the captain down.

title: Smugglers at Kalkara
blurb: Scala's smugglers are using the old chapel as a depot. Burn it out.

title: The Palisade Swimmers
blurb: More Turkish swimmers are cutting at the stakes. Drive them off before the guard changes.

title: The Sapper Nest
blurb: Turkish sappers are digging at the foot of the Post of Castile. Fill in their trench.

title: The Foragers
blurb: A foraging party is stripping the last barley fields of the valley. Send them back empty-handed.

title: Beach Pickets
blurb: Turkish pickets watch the cliffs above Ġnejna. Take them down quietly.

title: The Galley Guard
blurb: Scala's hirelings are guarding the beached boats. Their mercenary pay does not stretch to dying.

title: The Trench Sentries
blurb: Scala's captain leaves a thin line of sentries in the Castile trenches. Cut it.
